context: Grandma teaches her grandchild about birds and feathers in nature
purpose: Teach: 羽/脚/坂/食い/漏れ/流さ/精度/実習

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: 見て、坂の上の木に鳥が二羽とまってるよ。
lines.en: Look, two birds are perched on the tree at the top of the slope.
lines.style: Warm grandmotherly voice, gentle and observant tone

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ほんとだ！脚が細くて長いね、おばあちゃん。
lines.en: Oh yeah! Their legs are thin and long, grandma.
lines.style: Excited child voice, curious and bright tone

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: あの鳥はね、虫を食いに地面に降りてくるの。
lines.en: Those birds come down to the ground to eat insects.
lines.style: Soft teaching tone, patient explanatory grandmother voice

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: あ、羽が一枚落ちてる！拾ってもいい？
lines.en: Ah, a feather has fallen! Can I pick it up?
lines.style: Eager child voice, delighted discovery tone

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: いいけど、ちょっと水が漏れてる屋根の下にあったから、後で手を洗おうね。
lines.en: Sure, but it was under a roof that's leaking a bit, so let's wash your hands later.
lines.style: Caring grandmother tone, gentle and practical reminder voice

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: テレビで流されてた鳥の番組で、羽のつくりの精度がすごいって言ってた！
lines.en: On a bird show that was on TV, they said the precision of how feathers are made is amazing!
lines.style: Enthusiastic child voice, excitedly sharing what he learned

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: おばあちゃんも若い頃、先生になる実習で子どもたちに鳥の話をしたのよ。
lines.en: When I was young, during my training to become a teacher, I told children about birds too.
lines.style: Reminiscent warm voice, nostalgic gentle storytelling tone

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: へえ、すごい！ぼくも大きくなったら鳥のこと勉強する！
lines.en: Wow, amazing! When I grow up I'll study birds too!
lines.style: Bright energetic child voice, determined and joyful
